item.text: {"chapter_id":"4B","chapter_overview":"López Obrador governed within a still-competitive electoral system with active opposition, courts, and independent media, but his 2023 record materially weakened institutional constraints through electoral and transparency reforms, militarization, pressure on critics, and unresolved surveillance and accountability failures. Some independent institutions successfully constrained the executive, and formal rights and electoral competition persisted.","entries":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0051-E019","reason_to_read":"Best compact
